thread:
Anna (PM): quick intake for a small-scope PRD — runtime compatibility matrix for the new model-routing policy. problem: customers see inconsistent latency when requests are routed to quantized variants; we need clear acceptance criteria for rollouts and a minimal set of telemetry to validate.
Jay (Eng): got it. can you list the concrete goals + non-goals?
Anna (PM): goals: 1) define measurable latency and correctness windows for fallback routing; 2) surface per-route perf delta (hosted vs quantized) in console; 3) PRD must include rollout gating criteria and automated rollback triggers. non-goals: rearchitecting the routing layer, end-to-end benchmarking infra (we'll reuse existing harness).
Lee (Eng-ML): edge cases to call out: short-context prompts where quantization sometimes regresses completion probability, and streaming sessions where chunked KV cache differs. we should add a manual eval set for short-context-heavy customers.
Sofia (ProdOps): success metrics I'd expect: - median latency delta <= 10ms for 90th pct of requests after routing change - error rate increase <= 0.05% - no customer-visible regressions on our top 5 eval prompts.
Anna (PM): acceptance criteria draft: - telemetry: per-route tokens, median/95/99 latency, error counts, and model-variant tag in traces. - rollout gate: canary (1% traffic) 24h stability -> 10% 48h -> full 7 days; automatic rollback if 95p latency increases > 20ms or errors spike > 50%. - QoS: streaming sessions must not increase per-chunk latency by >5ms.
Jay (Eng): implementation notes: will need sampler to tag traces with variant and cache-hit status. also a fast path in runtime to annotate requests for console. estimate ~5 dev days + 2 days QA.
Lee (Eng-ML): for evals I'll prepare a small PR with 200 prompt pairs (short-context and long-context) and a scoring script. can we reuse the existing eval gate? Anna: yes, tie it to the eval-gate in Optimize.
Sofia (ProdOps): ops checklist: - dashboard tiles for per-route delta - alerting rules for rollouts - runbook entry for rollback steps. I can draft the dashboard after a quick wire.
Anna (PM): tradeoffs/non-goals reminder: we are not doing automatic quantization changes per-customer. policy is per-route variant only. also not planning any UI for variant selection in this PRD.
Jay (Eng): question: do we need canary across regions or just region-local? some customers route multi-region.
Anna (PM): region-local canary is minimum. note in PRD: call out multi-region customers need a cross-region strategy but mark as stretch.
ops-bot: Reminder: new PRD drafts should include an acceptance-matrix file in /docs/prds.
Lee (Eng-ML): edge-case: model fallback loops (variant A -> B -> A) if cache warming fails. include a max-fallback-count = 1 in acceptance criteria.
Anna (PM): added: max-fallback-count = 1, cache-warm telemetry required.
Sofia (ProdOps): timeline ask: PM wants a scoped RFC by EOW and a playable canary next sprint. I'll block time for dashboard.
Anna (PM): I'll draft the PRD doc this afternoon with problem statement, goals, non-goals, success metrics, acceptance criteria, and a minimal rollout plan. ping @Jay and @Lee for a quick review before EOD.
Jay (Eng): will review.
Lee (Eng-ML): will review too.
Sofia (ProdOps): thanks — will add ops items in the PRD. :thumbsup:
Anna (PM): thanks everyone.
